root_text.title: දුම්මෙධ ජාතකය
root_text.author: A.P. de Zoysa

previous.name: The Spirit in the Clump of Grass

root_text.text:
• ඛුද්දකනිකාය
  • ජාතක
  • (පඨමො භාගො)
  • 1. එකක නිපාතය
  • 13. කුසනාළි වර්ගය

122. දුම්මෙධ ජාතකය

Msdiv 122“නුවණ නැත්තේ යසස් ලැබ තමහට අනර්ථයක් කෙරේ. තමහටද අන්‍යයන්ටද හිංසා පිණිස පිළිපදී යයි” කීයේය.

දුම්මෙධජාතකං දුතියං.

AP de Zoysa edition.

suttaplex.blurb: “Exalted station breeds a fool great woe.”—This story was told by the Master while at the Bamboo-grove, about Devadatta. For the Brethren had met together in the Hall of Truth, and were talking of how the sight of the Buddha’s perfections and all the distinctive signs of Buddhahood maddened Devadatta; and how in his jealousy he could not bear to hear the praises of the Buddha’s utter wisdom.
